shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json
git log --oneline -5 && git status --short
find /workspace/app /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---NEXT CONFIG---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json

cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -5 && echo "--- navigation exports ---" && cat node_modules/next/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "--- grep forbidden in navigation ---" && cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60
grep -rn "authInterrupts" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20
grep -n "forbidden\|unauthorized" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.d.ts

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/forbidden.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK ==="; grep -rn "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | grep -i "forbid\|unauth\|http-access"

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/forbidden.js; echo "=== fallback errors ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/client/components/http-access-fallback/; echo; cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/http-access-fallback/http-access-fallback.js

grep -rn "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== conventions ==="; grep -rln "'forbidden'" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-app-loader/index.js node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== FILE_TYPES ==="; grep -rn "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-app-loader/index.js | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
(npm run start -- -p 3111 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "up after ${i}s"; break; fi; done

echo "=== GET /admin (role: user) ==="; curl -s -i http://localhost:3111/admin | head -12; echo; echo "=== body markers ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/admin | grep -o "403 · Forbidden\|403 · Forbidden\|don't have access\|Admin Dashboard" | sort -u
cp app/admin/page.tsx /tmp/page.bak && sed -i "s/^export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'/\/\/ export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'/" app/admin/page.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12

pkill -f "next-server\|next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; (npm run start -- -p 3112 > /tmp/next-start2.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3112/ 2>/dev/null && { echo "up"; break; }; done; echo "=== static /admin ==="; curl -s -i http://localhost:3112/admin | head -3; echo "=== visible body content? ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3112/admin | grep -c "__next_error__"
cp /tmp/page.bak app/admin/page.tsx && grep -n "force-dynamic" app/admin/page.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8

pkill -f "next-server\|next start\|next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; (npm run dev -- -p 3113 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 60); do sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3113/ 2>/dev/null && { echo "dev up"; break; }; done
echo "=== role: user ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3113/admin

cp app/lib/auth.ts /tmp/auth.bak && sed -i "s/role: 'user', \/\/ Not an admin/role: 'admin',/" app/lib/auth.ts && grep -n "role:" app/lib/auth.ts && sleep 3 && echo "=== role: admin ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3113/admin && curl -s http://localhost:3113/admin | grep -o "Admin Dashboard\|Signed in as [^<]*"

cat > /tmp/nullsess.py <<'EOF'
import re
p='app/lib/auth.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""  return {
    userId: '123',
    role: 'admin',
    name: 'John Doe',
  }""","  return null")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 /tmp/nullsess.py && grep -n "return null" app/lib/auth.ts && sleep 3 && echo "=== session: null ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3113/admin

cp /tmp/auth.bak app/lib/auth.ts && sleep 3 && echo "=== restored mock (role: user) ===" && grep -n "role: 'user'" app/lib/auth.ts && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "final status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3113/admin; pkill -f "next dev\|next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned
git status --short && echo "=== diff of tracked files ===" && git diff -- tsconfig.json
cat .gitignore; echo "=== who made AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md ==="; ls -la AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null; head -5 CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "typecheck exit=$?"
